# SCHLÜSSELMACHER24 - Architecture & Metadata

## Architecture Blueprint (JC-AUDITOR-ARCHITECT-v1)

This project strictly adheres to the following architectural guidelines:
- Next.js 16+ App Router, React 19.2+, TypeScript 5.5+
- Server Component Supremacy & Async Request APIs (await params/searchParams)
- React 19 Server Actions (useActionState, useOptimistic, useTransition)
- TypeScript Strictness: No enums, strict typing
- Styling: Tailwind CSS v4 / Native Modern CSS with OKLCH Color Space
- Swiss High-End Light Mode Design System

For more details, see the `.jules` directory containing the `revolution-plan.json` and `architecture-matrix.md`.
